title: Actix-web vs Axum: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
Actix-web vs Axum: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

- Throughput: Actix-web generally leads in raw throughput due to its mature Tokio runtime and actor model.
- Latency: Axum often shows lower latency in specific benchmarks due to its lighter-weight design and integration with Tower.
- Consistency: Both offer high consistency, but Actix-web's actor model can simplify managing shared state.
- Failure Modes: Axum's reliance on standard Rust error handling and Tower middleware offers predictable failure management.
- Operational Overhead: Axum is often considered easier to integrate into existing Rust projects due to its API style.

Recommendation: For extreme throughput and battle-tested performance, Actix-web. For ease of integration and modern Rust features, Axum.
